ftp_mode.description: Default operation mode: active, passive, auto, or gate.

anon_password.description: Password sent for anonymous FTP transfers.

prompt.description: Command line prompt displayed in interactive mode.

rprompt.description: Right-side prompt displayed in interactive mode.

verbose.description: Enable verbose mode to show server responses and stats.

sslnoverify.description: Disable SSL certificate verification for HTTPS/FTPES.

auto_login.description: Attempt to automatically log in using .netrc or credentials.

prompt_off.description: Disable interactive prompting during multiple file transfers.

hash.description: Print hash signs (#) for each block of data transferred.

max_rate.description: Maximum transfer rate in bytes per second. 0 disables throttling.

xferbuf_size.description: Size of the socket send and receive buffers for transfers in bytes.

initial_commands.description: List of tnftp commands to execute on startup or connection initialization. Items are flat strings representing commands like 'passive', 'ascii', 'cd /pub'. Note: tnftp does not have a standalone config file for commands; this template simulates a 'rc' or 'init' script behavior often found in wrappers or netrc macdefs. For a strict 'config file' for a service, this might be empty if the service relies on CLI flags, but tnftp(1) implies state via 'set' commands which can be scripted or placed in .netrc macdef init. Since tnftp(1) doesn't have a /etc/tnftp.conf, this template represents a script/config hybrid often used to wrap the command with defaults.
